notes.title: Version 1.1 released
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First, if you've taken the time to play this game, thank you! I really appreciate everyone's support and feedback. A few players reported feeling motion sickness while playing, so in light of that, this version includes the following changes:

- Changes the default FOV from 65 to 75
- Adds an FOV slider, accessible by pressing the 'Esc' key
- Adds a toggle to enable a horizon line (My thinking here is it may help players with motion difficulties better orient themselves in space.)
- Some tweaks to make mouse aim feel more accurate, less "floaty" (Hopefully this also helps.)
- General bug fixes

That's all! I hope this makes it so everyone has an easier time with the game. Thanks again for playing, and have a Happy Thursday.
